title: Naming feelings
examples: What does your face look like when you are happy?
Can you show me how you look when you are angry?
What does your body do when you feel worried?

explain.say: Let us talk about how we feel inside. Sometimes we feel happy and sometimes we feel sad.
When you are happy, you might smile a lot. Your body might jump up and down a little bit.
When you feel sad, your face might droop a little bit. You might want to sit down quietly.
Sometimes we feel angry, and our body might feel warm. We might stomp our feet a little bit.
If you are worried, your tummy might feel fluttery. You might hold your hands close to your chest.
A common mistake is thinking that one feeling is always better than another. All feelings are okay to have sometimes. Learning names helps you understand each one.

faq.a: A feeling is how you feel inside your heart. It is a way of knowing about yourself.
asks: How do I know how I feel?

faq.a: We get angry when something makes us feel unfair or when we are frustrated. It is okay to feel angry.

faq.q: Is it okay to cry when I am sad?
faq.a: Yes, it is okay to cry when you are sad. Crying helps let the sad feeling out a little bit.

faq.q: How do I show I am worried?
faq.a: You can show you are worried by looking down at your shoes. You might also breathe very slowly.

faq.q: Does being happy mean I never get sad?
faq.a: No, we feel lots of different things every day. It is normal to feel happy and sad both.

facts: Feelings are normal parts of being a person.
Your body can give clues about how you feel.
Smiling is a way to show you are happy.
Taking deep breaths can help when you feel worried.

quiz.say: If your tummy feels fluttery, which feeling might you have?
quiz.why: A fluttery tummy is a common body clue for feeling worried.

wrong.1: When happy, your body usually feels light, not fluttery.
wrong.2: Sadness usually makes you feel heavy, not fluttery.
wrong.3: Anger often makes your body feel hot or tight, not fluttery.

quiz.say: When you feel angry, what might your body do?
quiz.why: Stomping feet is a strong action that can show you are angry.

wrong.2: Jumping high is more like being excited or happy.
wrong.3: Sleeping is resting, not showing anger.

quiz.say: Which feeling is shown by a drooping face?
quiz.why: A drooping face is a clear sign that you might be feeling sad.

wrong.1: Anger usually makes your face look tight or red.
wrong.2: Happiness makes your face lift up into a smile.
wrong.3: Worry usually makes your face look thoughtful or tense.
